description: Open-versus-closed repeat probe on mean-pooled ESM++ hidden states; demotes proteins it calls closed (talea_discovery_score + weight * min(0, logit p_open)).
pooling: mean over residue tokens (special tokens excluded), concatenated in layer order

provenance.fit: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression (C 0.1, balanced) folded into one linear map
provenance.training_set: Kinsey Long's SAERepeat training split, open (1) vs closed (0) repeats, minus every protein with a homolog in any Talea benchmark (>= 20% identity over >= 50% of the shorter sequence: RepeatsDB 452, ECOD 1,295, CATH 819, pMEGA4, native 887, tubes, DPANN) and minus CATH-lockbox superfamilies; 1,879 proteins
provenance.weight_chosen_on: Kinsey's held-out-family test split (open vs closed + none, AP), penalty-only form
provenance.validation: CATH 819 AP +0.021 [+0.004, +0.040]; ECOD balanced AP 0.988 -> 0.992; RepeatsDB 452 and pMEGA4 unchanged

credits: Training data and splits from Kinsey Long's SAERepeat repeat set.
